name: Embassy Citadel

location.address: Dr. Elijah Moses Road, Worli, Mumbai 400 018

headlines: ALL THE PLACES TO GO. WITHOUT GOING ANYWHERE.
THE WORLD CHANGES AT THE DOOR.
YOUR PRIVATE HAVEN IN THE SKY.
THE BEST SEAT IN THE CITY.
WHERE THE SKYLINE IS AS WELL-DRESSED AS YOU.

story.intro: The city demands your time. Your patience. Your energy. Embassy Citadel is designed to give it all back.
story.positioning: A self-contained world — not by isolation, but by design.
story.proof: Rising over 300 metres, with curated amenities spanning eight levels. One definitive vertical landmark. Slender. Elegant. Distinguished not by excess, but by restraint.
